children: Eaton will invest more than $242 million to build a new manufacturing plant in Arkansas that will double the U.S. capacity of customized electrical enclosures from its Fibrebond business.

Eaton on Wednesday said it expects to create 1,200 new manufacturing, electrical and operations jobs at the plant in North Little Rock, Ark., as the power-management company works to meet growing demand across data center, utility, industrial and digital communications markets.
Eaton acquired Fibrebond for $1.4 billion in April 2025.
